requests.heading: My requests
requests.intro: Everything you have submitted, including your production credentials requests.
requests.emptyHtml: You have not submitted any requests yet. To request production credentials, open the application you have tested in Manage applications.
requests.unavailable: Your requests could not be loaded just now. Try again in a few minutes.

nextSteps.heading: Next steps
stepsHtml: Browse the API catalogue to find the APIs you want to test.
Create an application for Try it now and add those APIs.
Test your software with the APIs, using your Try it now credentials.
When you are ready for live data, go to Manage applications, choose the application you have tested and request production credentials for it. You can follow the request under My requests.
